about: I’m a Frontend Engineer and AI Frontend Engineer with 6 years of Angular experience and an M.S. in Data Science. My focus is building interfaces that are clear, responsive, accessible, and easy to use.

I work with Angular v16+, standalone components, signals, React, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript. I connect thoughtful interface design with reusable components, state management, and API integration.

My data science background helps me bring AI into the frontend: copilots, conversational interfaces, and model-backed workflows. I focus on how people interact with these features, including loading states, feedback, and clear user controls.
I’m seeking Frontend Engineer and AI Frontend Engineer roles where I can build modern web products and make intelligent features useful to the people using them.
